مَقْذُوذٌ see مُقَذَّذٌ in three places. ―
-b2- أُذُنٌ مَقْذُوذَةٌ, (S, M, L, K,) and ↓ مُقَذَّذَةٌ , (M, L, K,) an ear of a rounded shape (M, L, K,) as though it were pared. (S, L.) [You say,] لَهُ أُذُنَانِ مَقْذُوذَتَانِ He (a horse) has two ears shaped like the feathers of an arrow. (A.) ―
-b3- هُوَ مَقْذُوذُ القَفَا He has his hair clipped at the back of the neck. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
